name: artekka-kits
description: Artekka's reusable Claude Code kits. This repo is both the marketplace and two plugins: the orchestration kit and the optional status HUD.

plugins.name: orchestration-kit
plugins.description: Multi-session claimable agent board + verification workflow.

plugins.name: status-hud
plugins.description: Optional pixel-style status HUD: every session's context fill, model and activity, plus host load, as a band above the prompt or a side pane.
